title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Organizational Change Behavior and Culture
description: The aim of this course is to develop an understanding of the interplay between organizational change, behavior, and culture and their impact on achieving business goals.
longDescription: This course explores the dynamics of organizational change and its relationship to behaviour and culture within the workplace. Learners will gain insights into the factors that drive organizational change and learn how to navigate the complexities of change management effectively. Through case studies and interactive discussions, students will develop strategies for creating a culture of change readiness and driving sustainable business growth.
